task: My grandmother only understands Telugu. Make this useful for her.

steps: 1. Read the English source with read_text to check its content.
2. Translate the complete paragraph into Telugu using translate_text with verification.
3. Read the Telugu translation aloud using synthesize_speech with verification, then deliver the text and audio.

deliverables.description: Complete Telugu translation in native script.
AI-generated Telugu reading of the complete translation.

assumptions: Since the grandmother only understands Telugu, provide a complete Telugu translation plus audio for accessibility.
Use the default Telugu female voice and neutral delivery; no specific duration is required.

final_answer:
Created two versions for your grandmother:
- A complete Telugu translation of the paragraph.
- A Telugu audio reading (about 29 seconds), using an AI-generated female voice.

The translation passed verification. The audio check found a close match overall, but could not confirm the spoken number “350”; it is preserved correctly in the written translation.
